label: Free 2.0
title: Pick rule set versions and validate whole folders
lede: Summand 2.0 builds on the 1.1 line: one ruleSets option decides which official rules run and in which version, and validateMany checks whole folders of invoices in parallel. The 2.0 release itself makes result messages a stable contract and requires Node.js 22.

items.title: One option for rule sets and versions
items.text: ruleSets replaces the old xrechnung switch. You choose EN 16931 and XRechnung, and can pin the older XRechnung 2.5.0 to reproduce a verdict that was given under it. The result lists the versions that really ran.
items.outputTitle: Output for a UBL invoice whose amount due was changed to 1.00 (valid, ran, then each error)
items.output:
valid: false
ran: en16931-ubl@1.3.16, xrechnung-ubl@2.5.0
BR-CO-16 error en16931-ubl

items.title: See exactly which rules are bundled
items.text: summand rules lists every bundled rule set with version, rule count, licence and source, and shows which version is the default. Your stored verdicts can name the rules that produced them.

items.title: Validate folders with a worker pool
items.text: validateMany spreads files over worker threads and returns results in input order. A file that cannot be read becomes a SUM-BATCH error entry, never a crash, so an unreadable file never looks like a valid one.

items.title: Stable rule codes in every message
items.text: Every error, warning and info carries a stable id, a severity and the rule set it came from, in English or German. 2.0 documents these fields as the contract, so you can build filters and reports on them.
items.outputTitle: Output for the same changed invoice
items.output:
UNGÜLTIG falsch.xml  XRechnung 3.0  1 Fehler, 0 Warnung(en)
  Fehler  BR-CO-16 (Zeile 88): Fälliger Zahlungsbetrag (BT-115) = Gesamtbetrag der Rechnung mit Umsatzsteuer (BT-112) - Gezahlter Betrag (BT-113) + Rundungsbetrag (BT-114).

note: Upgrading from 1.x: replace the xrechnung option with ruleSets, and use Node.js 22 or newer. Peppol rules and the Factur-X EXTENDED Schematron are not bundled.
